name: Dog Adoption
description: Give a rescued dog a forever home. Every dog is health-checked, sterilised, vaccinated and microchipped before adoption.

name: Cat Adoption
description: Adopt a rescued cat or kitten. Our team will help match a cat to your home and lifestyle.

name: Sterilisation Clinic
priceNote: per animal, subsidised for community members
description: Low-cost sterilisation for pets in surrounding communities to reduce the number of unwanted litters.

name: Vaccination Drive
description: Monthly community vaccination drive covering rabies and core vaccines.

name: Foster Care Programme
priceNote: food and vet care are supplied by us
description: Open your home to an animal for a few weeks while it recovers or waits for adoption.

name: Volunteer Programme
description: Walk dogs, socialise cats, help at adoption days or assist in the office. No experience required.

name: Sponsor an Animal
description: Cover the monthly food and medical care of one animal until it finds a home.

name: School Education Visit
description: A 45-minute interactive talk on responsible pet ownership and animal welfare for learners.
